title: Wholesome German Bread Flour Flatbread
description: This vegan-friendly flatbread is light and flaky, perfect for a wholesome breakfast or snack.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour and salt.
Stir in yeast and olive oil. Mix until combined; do not overmix.
Gradually add water to achieve desired consistency (about 2 cups total).
Fold dough thoroughly then turn out onto floured surface.
Knead for about 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Grease a mixing bowl, place dough in, cover with damp cloth or plastic wrap. Let rise at room temperature for 1 hour.
Roll out dough to desired thickness and shape. Prick bottom with fork to prevent puffing during baking.
Preheat oven to 200 degrees C (392 F). Place flatbread on baking sheet, bake for 8 minutes until golden brown.
Sprinkle cardamom seeds evenly over top of baked flatbread before serving.
